configuration_note: SciFact and NFCorpus include protected-prefix refinement; FiQA reports the earlier fifteen-candidate configuration. Matched optimizers use the corresponding configuration; these are distinct policies within the L6-guided GAS family.

statistics.policy: Within-query nDCG differences <= 1e-12 are numerical ties before paired tests; rankings and reported raw means unchanged.
statistics.reason: Averaging five identical seeded metric values can introduce one-ULP differences from a deterministic control.

limitations: Thirty-two training-confirmation queries per dataset; not a fresh retrieval-effectiveness evaluation.
Native circuit metrics use at most two fixed seed-0 queries per dataset and pool; synthetic cells are labelled.
Native complete iteration synthesis is limited to eight decisions; validation simulation to five.
MPS inverse-expected-state/local-Z validation uses zero truncation threshold, bond cap 128, and a 1e-8 infidelity bound.
Qiskit 0.46/Aer 0.13.3 are preserved; no package upgrade or physical QPU execution.
Circuit constants come from classical saved coefficients; construction costs are recorded.
Per-method allocation replay is excluded from selector timing; whole-worker RSS includes its entire query grid.
u/cx counts assume unrestricted connectivity; no hardware-routing or quantum-speedup claim.

hardware_record.measurement_boundary: Recorded on the study host during resource collection; individual worker peaks and thread budgets are in study results.
